$doc: KINETIC-TEXT sound set: the sound effects Mike's 2023 'Growth Marketer vs Growth Hacker' video fired on its text pops, role labels, icon pops, cards and whip-pans, lifted from the Premiere project (differences revision_1.prproj) with the exact trigger each one had. Use them the same way: every kinetic text / label / icon / card lands WITH its sound; the two role labels of a head-to-head video keep two DIFFERENT sounds (cash-register = label A, wooden-rattle-whoosh = label B) and reuse them every time the labels return. the time-ordered map is video-creation/assets/effects/themes/kinetic-text-2023/CUE-SHEET.md. Originals in ./_source/. Mirrors ../Impacts/library.json and ../accents/library.json. 2026-10-25: the MOTION side (the `devices` block that lived here) MOVED to the EFFECTS library video-creation/assets/effects/library.json (devices + themes); every sound row's `device` field points at a device id there. This folder = the SOUNDS of the kinetic-text-2023 theme, nothing else.
$schema_note: `trigger` = the on-screen event the sound was cut to in 2023 (the field to pick by). `reference_cues_main_sequence` = seconds in the 2023 main-sequence.mp4 where you can hear it in context. `attack_sec` = seconds from file start to the loudest sample: place the file so that attack lands ON the frame the text appears (the whooshes peak late, the pops peak at once). `type` kinetic-text is a pick category, not a mood; `mood_class` neutral for all (the 2023 video was bright/explainer).
